Chapter 1
"You're late," said Elara. At the harbor she and Cade renewed their oath and became sworn kin, sailing north together.
Chapter 2
Three years later, war reached the river. Elara died on the ramparts; the host mourned her for three days.
Chapter 3
A year on, Elara said: "I have returned." The crowd recoiled — the dead do not walk.
Chapter 4
Elara now called Cade her father. The harbor oath had become a bitter jest.
Chapter 5
The half of the tiger tally hidden in her sleeve was never mentioned again.
